title: LBJ pushes Earl Warren into the commission; Dulles runs it

tellings.quote: And he they lie to to Chief Justice Warren to Chief Justice Warren to get to chair the waring commission. And they put Alan Dulles on who was the de facto run guy that ran the Warren Commission,

plain: After President Kennedy was killed in 1963, Lyndon Johnson's people reportedly lied to Chief Justice Earl Warren to get him to chair the Warren Commission, the official inquiry into the killing, and then put Allen Dulles, a former head of the CIA, on it as the man who really ran it. The lawyer Dan Sheehan tells Michels this as his own summary, without naming a source; if true, it would mean the inquiry was steered from inside by the intelligence world.
